armado: prompt final = bloque_estilo + ' ' + prompt + ' ' + (bloque_hoja si tipo=='hoja', bloque_fondo si tipo=='fondo')
bloque_estilo: Chunky pixel art game UI for a 2D top-down zombie survival game set in a university engineering school at night. Flat shading with 2-3 tones per color, thick near-black outlines, no gradients, no smooth anti-aliased shading, consistent pixel size across the whole image. Palette: dark navy panels #1B1F3B, teal #2EC4B6, orange #FF9F1C, purple #9B5DE5, toxic slime green #7CFC00, warm yellow, red for health. Match the pixel style, outline weight and colors of the reference image(s) exactly.
bloque_hoja: Layout: arrange exactly the listed items as separate objects on a perfectly flat, solid pure magenta #FF00FF background, in a clean grid, with very wide empty gutters between items. Each item is fully inside its own cell, centered, large, not touching any other item or the image edges, all items at the same scale and pixel size. No cast shadows or glow spilling onto the background. No text, no letters, no numbers, no watermark. Do not use magenta inside any item.
bloque_fondo: Full-screen background illustration only. No UI panels, no frames, no buttons, no bars, no text, no letters, no watermark.

REMOVE the green frame, the panels, the buttons and the FDI-Z logo. Add the four heroes (references 2-5, keep their exact designs) standing in the left foreground, ready to fight. Keep the lower-center area uncluttered.
Dark empty school hallway with lockers and soft blue night light, wide uncluttered center. Remove the cards, buttons and title panel.

Dark night classroom with chalkboard full of diagrams, desks, moonlit window, tool wall on the left and computers on the right. No characters, no panels. Leave a soft spotlight circle on the floor at the left.
Dark school hallway with lockers and a door, blue night light. No characters, no panels, no coin counter, no items.

Keep the sunrise sky, the school silhouette, the parked yellow school bus (no lettering on the bus) and the four heroes celebrating at the left. Remove the title panel, the results panel and the buttons. Keep the right half calm and uncluttered.
Keep the dark red-vignette hallway, the scared heroes and the zombies with the janitor zombie in front. Remove the results panel and the buttons. Keep the right side calm.

Two square-ish illustrations with no frame. 1) 'escape': the four heroes running through a parking lot at night toward a yellow school bus, zombies behind them, street lamps (no lettering on the bus). 2) 'jefe': the janitor zombie with a mop looming over a glowing green holographic map of the school with small green zombie figures on it.

Three versions of the game logo 'FDI-Z' in big chunky slime-green pixel letters dripping slime with a near-black outline, spelled exactly F D I - Z. 1) plain logo. 2) the logo above a small dark navy shield emblem with a green zombie hand. 3) a compact square version of the logo.
jobs.nota: Unica hoja que lleva texto (el logo). El BLOQUE_HOJA dice 'No text' pero se manda igual, tal cual: el logo es la excepcion aprobada.
